meta.description: جریان ۲: دریافت ورودی روزانه غیبت از پنل مدرسه، ثبت idempotent در جدول absences و اطلاع همان‌روز به ولی تأییدشده با تاریخ شمسی.

parameters.query: SELECT s.id AS student_id, s.name AS student_name FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN students s ON s.unique_code = $1 LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO absences (student_id, absence_date, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2::date, now()) ON CONFLICT (student_id, absence_date) DO UPDATE SET student_id = EXCLUDED.student_id RETURNING id;
SELECT p.chat_id AS chat_id FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN parents p ON p.student_id = $1 AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;
